All tools included

Built for miniature 3D printing

Every tool on STLACCESS is designed around one problem: getting the right scale for 3D printed tabletop miniatures. The calculator, reference library, and personal library work together so you can convert, save, and share scale percentages — all from your browser, all for free.

  • stlscale Engine — The main calculator for converting between any supported scales
  • Scale Reference Library — 45 verified conversion percentages with print-tested results
  • Personal Library — Save your most-used conversions in your browser

How these tools are built

By kitsorix, 3D printing hobbyist

All tools run entirely in your browser. There is no backend, no database, and no user tracking. The scale calculator uses a 175cm human baseline with eye-level at 160cm — the same reference point used by most of the tabletop miniatures community. Conversion percentages are printed and measured with digital calipers before they are published.

New scales are added when wargaming manufacturers release new systems or when enough users submit corrections through the feedback form. Every percentage is tested on my Bambu Lab A1 Mini before publishing.
